title.narrative: Cooperation between Ukrainian Social Partners and Danish Partners

description.narrative: The aim of the consultancy is to update and adjust the earlier prepared project document “Enhancing Social Dialogue towards Green and Just Transition in Ukraine 2022-2026” in order to reflect the changed context in post-invasion Ukraine and to define the possibilities to engage partners constructively in social dialogue in the early recovery phase and during the reconstruction of the Ukrainian economy and labour market. The overall objective of the adjusted intervention could be “Support to social partners at central and sector level to ensure an effective functioning of the Ukrainian labour market in a post-invasion Ukrainian context.” The vision guiding an adjusted engagement should focus on strengthening local partners’ capacity to engage in labour market reform processes while ensuring the competitive position of the companies is enhanced and that worker’s rights are respected, and a green and just transition is promoted. This could imply support at national level to the country’s reform efforts in building a conducive labour market that respects worker’s rights and support the reconstruction and the recovery of the country – as well as help strengthening employer’s associations, including their capacity to conduct local bargaining process (in line with EU standards). Bearing in mind the Danish commitment to try to promote recovery and reconstruction of Mykolaiv city/oblast, the possibility to add a preliminary targeted intervention regarding promotion of inclusive social dialogue in Mykolaiv should be explored.
